actions.name: calculate_numerology_profile
actions.description: Calculate a Pythagorean, Chaldean, Kabbalah/Gematria, or Ank Jyotish profile with method-specific name, date, transliteration, and optional interpretation settings.

profile.description: Profile alias or canonical versioned profile ID belonging to the selected system.

masterPolicy.description: Optional compatible master-number policy; normally let the provider derive it from the profile.

compoundPolicy.description: Evidence depth: compound_and_root or full_trace; Pythagorean also supports root_only.

nameSource.description: Choose birth or current for Kabbalah and Ank when both names are present. Chaldean uses its profile instead.

method.description: Numerology method and reproducibility settings. Omit profile and policies to use upstream defaults.

birth.description: Nonblank full name, at most 200 characters.

current.description: Nonblank full name, at most 200 characters.

script.description: ISO 15924 script code such as Latn or Hebr. Kabbalah can infer Hebr from unambiguous Hebrew names.

birth.description: Nonblank full name, at most 200 characters.

current.description: Nonblank full name, at most 200 characters.

transliteration.description: Caller-supplied Latin transliteration. Pythagorean and Chaldean use supplied values even for Latin input; Ank ignores them for Latn.

name.description: Birth and/or current names with explicit script and transliteration when needed.

calendar.description: Calendar identifier. Currently only gregory is supported.

locale.description: Subject locale. Interpretations for Pythagorean, Chaldean, and Kabbalah require exact en; Hindi localizes Ank labels.

timezone.description: Pythagorean cycle timezone: an IANA name or AUTO. Required when referenceDate is omitted.

city.description: City for AUTO timezone resolution when no reference date is provided.

latitude.description: Latitude for AUTO timezone resolution; provide longitude together.

longitude.description: Longitude for AUTO timezone resolution; provide latitude together.

subject.description: Numerology subject. Required birth dates and names depend on the selected system.

referenceDate.description: Explicit personal-cycle reference date. Otherwise provide a timezone in subject.

yearAnchor.description: Personal-cycle year anchor. Currently only calendar_year is supported.

includeInterpretations.description: Opt in to available versioned content. Defaults to false; unavailable content is reported as a nonfatal warning.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key. Reuse only when retrying the exact same POST request after a network failure.

inputSchema.description: Numerology profile input with four method-specific variants.

profile.description: Complete numerology profile, including resolved method policies, provenance, optional interpretations, and nonfatal warnings.
